title: How to Take Your Relationship to the Next Level
hook: Eight years of waiting can become one honest table conversation.
counterintuition: Commitment talks are for truth, not for cornering someone into the desired answer.

keyTakeaway: Commitment Clarity helps you stop managing what belongs to other people and put your energy into the next honest response.

implementationPlan.title: Commitment Clarity Practice
implementationPlan.coreSkill: The skill is to notice the moment when attention leaves the reader's own choices and starts managing another person. In this source, commitment clarity brings attention back to conduct, boundaries, requests, repair, or acceptance. The reader practices by naming the uncontrollable part and then choosing one honest action.

ifThenPlans.context: University of Alberta eight-year study echo
ifThenPlans.plan: If a situation resembles University of Alberta eight-year study, then pause before fixing the outcome and write the response that still belongs to you.
If a conversation starts to repeat Matthew Hussey and Audrey, then speak one clear sentence and stop trying to force agreement.
If the replay keeps pulling attention back to another person's reaction, then return to the source's control split and take one observable action.
If harm, coercion, or safety is involved, then use the source's hard edge before practicing release.
